item.title: Nine inducted into Cattaraugus County Sports Hall of Fame - Olean Times Herald
item.description: Nine inductees were honored at the 21st Annual Cattaraugus County Sports Hall of Fame Banquet on March 28 at the Gowanda Moose Lodge. Pictured, seated from left: Clifton Wheeler (Gowanda), Derek Hill (Cattaraugus-Little Valley), Kathy Stamets (Allegany-Limestone) and Dennis Turner Jr. (Olean); standing: Steve Fitzgerald (Salamanca), Jack Amphlett (Archbishop Walsh), Jim Duprey (Pioneer) and Chris Mendell (Ellicottville). Missing from the photo is Valerie Waldron Hedlund (Franklinville/Olean).
